laws.rule: Bromo Tengger Semeru: from 30 October 2024 foreign visitors pay Rp255,000 (about A$19.95 at the RBA rate of 30 October 2026) a day (including Rp5,000 insurance); Ranu Regulo Rp205,000 to visit, Rp210,000 to camp. Tickets must be bought online at bookingbromo.bromotenggersemeru.org; visitors without one are fined five times the fee.

layers.authority: Balai Besar KSDA Jawa Timur (nature conservation office, Ministry of Forestry), through the AyoKeTamanNasional booking platform
layers.process: Tickets for Kawah Ijen (Ijen crater nature recreation park) are booked online on the AyoKeTamanNasional platform. The name on the booking must match the visitor's official ID (a passport for a foreign visitor). Paid tickets cannot be cancelled, moved to another date or refunded for any reason. The platform lists a trial booking from visit dates of 18 May 2026. Climbing gate hours are 02:00 to 12:00 WIB (Western Indonesia Time). The page did not show ticket prices.

Visitors must carry and show a doctor's health certificate that is valid for at most 3 days before the visit date. The page advises people with heart disease, asthma, acute respiratory infection or other breathing disorders not to climb. It also asks visitors to bring anti-slip shoes, a warm jacket and a mask.

The park closes to visitors on set days for its routine 'Ijen Rijik' clean-up. The 2026 dates on the page are 5 June, 3 July, 7 August, 4 September, 2 October, 6 November and 4 December (the next from 7 November 2026 is 4 December). The park can also close at any time for weather, volcanic activity, field conditions or management decisions, announced through official notices.

sites.name: Trowulan, Majapahit capital site
sites.what: Archaeological remains of a Majapahit capital in Mojokerto include water structures, gateways and traces of habitation. Indonesia submitted Trowulan to UNESCO’s tentative list in 2009.
